description: Settings of the least-squares fits of one and two exponentials to the binned firing-rate change (Supp Fig 4), passed to scipy.optimize.curve_fit; weighted fits use sigma = s.e.m. of each bin mean and absolute_sigma = True. single: c + a exp(-t / tau), parameters (a, tau, c); double: c + a1 exp(-t / t1) + a2 exp(-t / t2), parameters (a1, t1, a2, t2, c), reported with t1 <= t2. p0 holds the starting values; the string mean_of_bin_means stands for the mean of the bin means. extra_starts lists further starting values; of all starts the fit with the lowest residual sum of squares is kept (the first on ties). bounds holds the lower and upper bounds (null: unbounded); method and max_nfev are passed to curve_fit.
